subject: Trial onramp: governance, owners, and initial action list
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@northbridge.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial onramp: governance, owners, and initial action list

Thanks again for the call this morning, Lena — good discussion and appreciate the clarity on your evaluation priorities. Quick written recap and an initial owner map so we can move to an onboarding sprint: 

Key success criteria (what Northbridge needs to validate):
- Latency: P95 generation latency <= 450ms for our 2k token workload (baseline test set attached).
- Cost: token cost target <= $0.03 per 1k tokens under continuous batching profile.
- Functional: end-to-end integration of inference output into your annotator pipeline with deterministic metadata passthrough.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 controls and audit log export for all trial traffic.

High-level evaluation plan + timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): mutual-action-plan sign-off and infra kickoff.
- Week 1: dedicated trial capacity provisioned + integration smoke tests.
- Week 2: run acceptance tests (latency/cost), initial QA pass.
- Week 3: stakeholder readout / decision to expand or iterate.

Proposed ownership (initial RACI-lite):
- Infrastructure (provisioning, VPC, capacity): Ben Carter (redwood) - R/A
- Application integration (API routing, schema, SDK): Marissa Cole (redwood) - R/A
- Security & compliance liaison (evidence collection, audit logs): Diego Fernandez (redwood) - C
- Northbridge trial owner (integration + acceptance sign-off): Lena Ortiz - A
- Procurement & billing: procure@northbridge.ai - C

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Lena: confirm procurement contact and whether we can proceed with a one-month trial PO or a short-term MSA addendum.
2) Ben & Marissa: I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and the Redwood security checklist — please review and flag anything missing.
3) Lena: preferred time for a 30-min onramp (we suggested Wed or Thu afternoon PST).

Attachments: Northbridge_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.pdf (MAP draft), redwood_security_checklist.csv

Thanks — I’ll schedule the onramp once we have procurement contact and a preferred slot.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Solutions Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@northbridge.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procure@northbridge.ai
Date: Mon, 8 Sep 2025 13:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Trial onramp: governance, owners, and initial action list

Diego — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few things from our side: 

- Procurement: please route onboarding PO requests to procure@northbridge.ai. They typically need a short SOW + price table before we can approve (I can expedite once we have that).
- Timeline: Wed 10 Sep 1pm PT works for the 30-min onramp (we prefer a brief walkthrough and then handoff to our infra team).
- Security: we do need SOC2 evidence (test report) and a sample audit-log export to validate ingestion. Can you point me to the SOC2 cert and share a sample logs CSV?

Also copying Andy from procurement in case he has any timeline constraints. Looking forward to the MAP — will review and return comments by EOD Tue.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product Operations
Northbridge AI
